# A board column drag carries the whole column, not only its header

## Context

The operator, reading the home page's plan preview on 20 Nov 2026: "drag&drop for task board headers still incomplete (moving headers instead of columns)". When a user drags a column by its header, the drag shows the header alone. The column's cards stay behind in their slot until the drop.

## The Problem

A user who picks up a column expects to carry the column: its title, its count and its cards. Today the proxy is a header strip floating over an untouched board. The gesture reads as moving a label, not reordering a stage. #21632's example will show this drag enlarged, "a header at rest, on hover and while dragged", so the example cannot ship the gesture as it stands.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.board.ColumnSortZone#getDragElement()` (`src/board/ColumnSortZone.mjs:124-135`) returns `handleNode || draggedItem.header.vdom`, "so the drag proxy clones only the column header". The class docblock (`:4-12`) says the same, so this is the shipped design, not a regression.
- The zone sorts `owner.items` horizontally with `.neo-board-column-header` as the handle (`dragHandleSelector`, `:34-36`) and commits once through `owner.moveColumn(fromIndex, toIndex)`. Locked columns stay pinned (`getPinnedItems`).
- Columns can be windowed (#21627: 10,000 cards), so the proxy must show only the column as rendered, never every card.
- Design authority: the operator, 20 Nov 2026: "drag&drop for task board headers still incomplete (moving headers instead of columns)". This supersedes the header-only proxy described in the docblock above.

## The Fix

1. `ColumnSortZone#getDragElement()` returns the dragged column's whole rendered node (header and the cards it currently renders), and the docblock says so.
2. While the drag runs, the column's slot holds an empty placeholder of the column's width, so the board shows where the column will land.
3. Collapse controls, locked columns, keyboard reorder and the single `moveColumn()` commit stay as they are.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A header drag shows a proxy with the column's header and its rendered cards. The original slot stays empty until the drop.
- [ ] The drop reorders the columns once (`moveColumn`), and a locked column neither moves nor gives up its index.
- [ ] A windowed column's proxy holds only its rendered cards.
- [ ] An e2e under `test/playwright/e2e/board/` asserts the proxy contains the column's cards. It is red on `dev`.
- [ ] Frames of the drag in the dark and the light theme on the pull request.

## Out of Scope

- Lanes mode (`laneField`), card drags, and the board example itself (#21632, which this ticket blocks).

* feat(board): a column drag carries the whole column, not only its header (#21650)

The proxy clones the column's whole tree, its header and the cards it renders, and the slot stays empty until the drop. The main-thread zone registry stays keyed on the header, so card drags inside a dragged column keep their zone, and the pointer offset is measured from the column, so it no longer drops by the border at drag start. DragZone hands its gesture data and drag-element rect to getMainThreadConfigs for that. The carried column fills its proxy instead of falling back to the default column width.
